answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because zenith only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
